description: This file defines extension methods for configuring Redis as a grain directory provider within the Orleans hosting framework. It provides methods to add Redis-based grain directories (default and named) to the silo builder, allowing integration of Redis persistence for grain directory entries.

classes.name: RedisGrainDirectoryExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods for configuring Redis as a grain directory in Orleans silo builders.

methods.name: UseRedisGrainDirectoryAsDefault
methods.description: Configures the silo to use Redis as the default grain directory.

methods.name: UseRedisGrainDirectoryAsDefault (overload)
methods.description: Configures the silo to use Redis as the default grain directory with options configuration.

methods.name: AddRedisGrainDirectory
methods.description: Adds a named Redis grain directory with options configuration.

methods.name: AddRedisGrainDirectory (overload)
methods.description: Adds a named Redis grain directory with options configuration using a different delegate.

methods.name: AddRedisGrainDirectory (private)
methods.description: Internal method that adds the Redis grain directory service configuration to the DI container.
